items.content_html: VisoraX is a full‑stack web app for detecting dangerous windshield glare and providing driver safety insights. The React (Vite) frontend lets you upload an image and hear alert sounds, while a Flask backend runs a YOLOv8n model and lightweight image analytics to compute an alert level with explainable sub‑scores.
